root: ^Fluorescent light, cold coffee, and a case board that's still mostly empty pins and string. Someone up the chain wants a status update by end of shift.

b: ^The Mask already knows which version of this update keeps the case open a little longer.
^You'll have to figure out what to tell them the honest way.

root: ^Nobody in the bullpen is wearing a mask. Filtered air, recycled and metered but clean, is one of the few things this building actually gets right.

b: ^Static usually has something to say about the air. In here, for once, it doesn't — and that silence is its own kind of tell about who this room was built for.
^It's just quiet, the way an office is supposed to be.

root: ^A detective two desks over rolls a stiff shoulder that never quite moved right after a field mod job nobody in the bullpen has ever asked about.

b: ^Graft doesn't flinch at it the way the street would. In here, a patched-together body is just a coworker's old case file, not a confession.
^Just someone stretching out a long shift, as far as you can tell.

root: ^File the update and get back to it.

done: ^Whatever you tell them, it buys you another day before someone above your pay grade calls this closed.
